description: Full detail for one UK planning application by stable id '{lpa_slug}:{app_ref}' (or by lpa + lpa_app_no, which may also be the council's own reference): the council's own reference, site address, application type, the development category, homes, unit mix, floorspace, change of use and a short title (read by a model from the description; null until read), dates, decision, appeal, whether the site is in a conservation area (a site-location test: conservation_area_check says when it could not judge, which is 'not confirmed'), and geocoding provenance: geocode.source 'council' when the location is the one the council itself publishes, with the location the address alone gives beside it, the site outline when the council publishes one, and the HM Land Registry title the site lies in (property_outline: a property outline, not the red line; England and Wales). Where the council files other applications under the same reference, other_records_under_reference lists them (id, address, dates), so check the address is the one meant. The companion to search_applications_nearby for building a site report. 404 if the application is not in the index.
